items.adaptation: Literal origins "*" + credentials:true RAISES Rack::Cors::CorsMisconfigurationError at boot in rack-cors 2.0.1 (lib/rack/cors/resource.rb:13: raise if public_resource && credentials==true), which would break boot. Per resources.rb#origins, @public_resources is set true ONLY for literal '*'; a Proc origin leaves it false. Used origins { |_source,_env| true } (reflect-ANY-origin) + credentials:true, which boots AND reflects any Origin with access-control-allow-credentials:true at request time. Same class, same Med-2 severity, strictly-worse real-world misconfig (reflect-any+credentials lets cross-origin read authed responses).
